title: The Boy Who Blamed His Little Sister: Owning Your Mistakes!

lines.text: Oops! A big glass of dark red grape juice tipped over onto the cream carpet!
lines.caps: *OOPS! A big glass of grape *JUICE | tipped over onto the cream *CARPET!

lines.text: Leo looked around in panic and shouted, Mom, baby Maya bumped into the table!
lines.caps: Leo looked around in *PANIC | and shouted, *MAYA bumped | into the *TABLE!

lines.text: Little Maya tilted her head with big sad tears—she didn't understand why!
lines.caps: Little Maya tilted her *HEAD | with big sad tears—she didn't *UNDERSTAND | *WHY!

lines.text: Leo watched his little sister cry, and a heavy gray cloud rained over his thoughts!
lines.caps: Leo watched his sister *CRY, | and a heavy gray cloud rained over his *THOUGHTS!

lines.text: Blaming someone innocent makes an accident ten times worse than the spill itself!
lines.caps: Blaming someone *INNOCENT | makes an accident ten times *WORSE | than the *SPILL!

lines.text: Leo took a deep breath, walked to Mom, and said, I lied. It was my elbow!
lines.caps: Leo took a deep *BREATH, | walked to Mom, and said, *I LIED. | It was my *ELBOW!

lines.text: Mom hugged Leo and Maya tightly: Accidents happen, but owning up takes real strength!
lines.caps: Mom hugged them both *TIGHTLY: | Accidents happen, but owning up takes *REAL | *STRENGTH!

lines.text: Together they grabbed towels and cleaned the rug until it sparkled clean!
lines.caps: Together they grabbed *TOWELS | and cleaned the rug until it *SPARKLED | *CLEAN!
